review_candidates.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
review_candidates.description_excerpt: System Integration: Manage complex integration programmes involving enterprise platforms, contact centre technologies, CRM solutions, cloud services and connectivity components while ensuring all technical deliverables align with client requirements. Resource & Delivery Management: Coordinate project resources across multiple countries and functions, balancing delivery priorities while maintaining visibility of resource utilisation, delivery risks and overall project health using Jira and relate
eligibility_evidence: As a publicly listed company, Toku continues to scale its presence and impact across international markets.

Beyond project execution, you will help strengthen project management standards, mentor less experienced project managers, and drive greater operational maturity as Toku continues to scale internationally.
Global Delivery: Successfully manage projects across multiple countries and regions while remaining flexible to collaborate across different time zones and travel internationally when required.
Working Style: Comfortable working across international time zones, travelling internationally when required, and adapting to the needs of global enterprise project delivery.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Toku combines local strategic consulting expertise, bespoke technology, regional in-country infrastructure, connectivity, and global reach to serve the diverse needs of enterprises operating at scale. System Integration: Manage complex integration programmes involving enterprise platforms, contact centre technologies, CRM solutions, cloud services and connectivity components while ensuring all technical deliverables align with client requirements. Technical Background: Practical experience managing technical implementations involving system integration, infrastructure, cloud platforms and enterprise software, with the ability to engage confidently in technical discussions without necessarily being a hands-on engineer. Project Governance: Extensive hands-on experience using Jira for project planning, delivery tracking, governance and reporting.
